method: Native-rate interleaved float PCM, FFmpeg normal metadata-aware decode. Contiguous per-sample peak across every channel at digital zero and -90/-75/-60/-45 dBFS. No downmix, resampling, RMS gating, trimming, overlap, speed/pitch changes or cache writes.
limitations: Low-level audio may be pronunciation, decay, breathing, noise or deliberate pause.
No native player output was captured. Null nativePlayerDelayMs means unmeasured, never zero.
FFmpeg skip/discard metadata is already applied in decoded PCM; subtracting it again risks clipping.

boundaries.interpretation: Source PCM edge quiet only, not a measured output gap or permission to trim.
